rewriteInstruction: The draft is strong but has three fixable issues. First, apply bold formatting to ALL verbatim website quotes — 'Explore ways to sell', 'Learn more about Shopify', and 'explore ways to sell' (second instance) must be **'bold-quoted'**. Second, make the H3 subheadings searchable by adding context that works for Google and skimmers: 'What changed: Education CTAs removed', 'Who this filters: Category-comparison shoppers', 'Audit: Count your education vs action CTAs'. Third, anchor the final test to Shopify's specific shift — instead of generic 'action CTAs', reference the feature-specific CTAs like Website Builder and Shop App as the benchmark. Finally, soften the causal claim in paragraph 2 ('This path no longer serves...') to conditional framing ('This path assumes visitors have already compared categories' or 'If a visitor is still comparing Shopify to custom sites, this path offers no entry point').
